body:
Independent adversarial review of this bounded #650 change is complete through
head `f24eb090d76e304201d27154e839e617c9e3fa74`.

Review findings #1219, #1221, #1222 and #1223 were filed and fixed. The final
source-parser correction was reviewed independently of its author; the review
also caught and corrected literal-quote handling before acceptance. Final
focused validation passed 100 tests, including actual source-review entry-point
negatives. The complete source modeling run reports 0 ERROR / 0 WARNING / 13
INFO, explicitly including the untyped-Attribute house-profile exception.

The actual isolated producer replay is separately accepted: 20,364 nodes,
521,217 edges, all 41,388 intended process-edge changes accounted for, and the
remaining 479,829 rows byte-identical. Raw source values, record identity,
prediction tiers and material ambiguity are preserved. Native METPO target
declarations were validated independently of consumer stubs. Neither this
review nor the replay certifies the current production graph.

Source-path checks found no prohibited self-loops or subclass cycles. Strict
source-only endpoint findings remain explicit: cross-source suppliers resolve
70,221 unique references, while the 18,374 external IMG references match the
known #1073 bucket. A separate unchanged upstream crosswalk contradiction was
filed as #1224; it is not a new GO mapping defect and is not silently declared
resolved here.

Exact-head full local pytest/tox gates and Python 3.10/3.11/3.12 CI are still
running. **Do not merge before all required checks finish successfully.**
The requester has explicitly authorized admin bypass of the collaborator
approval requirement after independent review and green CI; this note is not
a claim of a GitHub collaborator approval.

Reproducible local evidence:
`data/curation-goal-20260928.LFUKxk/`, including
`issue1223-independent-clearance.md`, the `adversarial-*.md` reports,
`source-replay/attempt-rmf78hj4/acceptance-result.json`, and
`final-gates-parallel-stdqnqo4/` (pending terminal status).

Final shipping gate passed on exactly
`f24eb090d76e304201d27154e839e617c9e3fa74`, based on
`bc7c6e73a13e90ddadd201d938530c59288aeeea`.

- Independent adversarial findings #1219, #1221, #1222 and #1223 are addressed;
  the final duplicate-header/quote parsing fixes were independently rechecked.
- `poetry run pytest`: 4,671 passed, 22 skipped, exit 0.
- `poetry run tox`: all stages pass; its pytest also reports 4,671 passed,
  22 skipped, exit 0.
- `poetry check --lock`: exit 0.
- `python scripts/generate_merge_configs.py --check`: exit 0.
- Local final receipt confirms unchanged head and clean tracked worktree.
- GitHub run 36533603187: Python 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12 all SUCCESS on that head.

Receipt: `data/curation-goal-20260928.LFUKxk/final-gates-parallel-stdqnqo4/results.json`
SHA-256: `abc5e80acdc012851d37c9d03a606fdfe60f8a7a18240401b364351ef1181758`.

The user explicitly authorized admin bypass after independent review and green
CI. GitHub's required collaborator approval remains unsatisfied; this independent
agent review is not represented as a collaborator approval.

This acceptance covers the bounded #650 code change and isolated source replay,
not a production transform/merge or release. Parent #650 remains open pending
rebuild/acceptance. The separate, user-approved evidence-preserving crosswalk
quarantine is being implemented under #1224.
